answer:
Done. `addToCart` in [cartActions.js](~/code/benchmark/okf-local/main/no_okf/work/g2_add_voucher/no_okf/codex/5/src/redux/actions/cartActions.js:16) now takes an optional last parameter `promoCode`; when given, it's attached to the request body as `promoCode` (sent on both the POST add and PUT update paths), and omitted entirely when not given. Only that file changed — a 4-line diff — and I preserved its CRLF line endings. Syntax-checked with Babel.

One note on the field name: the backend repo isn't available here (per AGENTS.md), so I derived it from this storefront's own conventions — the cart model it consumes already exposes `promoCode` (rendered in Cart.js), the promo API path is `cart/{id}/promo/`, and `discountCode` doesn't appear anywhere in the codebase. If the backend's cart-item request defines a different field name, it's a one-line fix.
